name: Altered
summary: Choose one obvious bodily augmentation: water breathing and a Swim Speed, natural armour, natural weapons, or night vision.

benefits.name: Augmentation
benefits.summary: Choose one visible augmentation: Aquatic Adaptation, Natural Armor, Natural Weapons or Night Vision.
benefits.text: Magic, science or a blend of both has changed your body. Choose one augmentation. It is plainly visible (stitches, grafts of another creature's parts, implants) unless you disguise it.

options.name: Aquatic Adaptation
options.summary: Breathe water, and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.
options.text: You have gills or moist membranes that let you breathe water, and webbed limbs that give you a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

options.name: Natural Armor
options.summary: AC 13 + your Dexterity or Constitution modifier (you choose which).
options.text: Scales, plates or thick hide give you an Armor Class of 13 + your Dexterity or Constitution modifier. Choose the ability when you pick this augmentation.

options.name: Dexterity
options.text: Your base Armor Class is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

options.name: Constitution
options.text: Your base Armor Class is 13 + your Constitution modifier.

options.name: Natural Weapons
options.summary: Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing damage, as fits the form.
options.text: Claws, fangs, horns or some other natural weapon let you make Unarmed Strikes that deal 1d8 damage on a hit. The damage is Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing, whichever suits the form you choose.

options.name: Bludgeoning
options.text: Your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage on a hit.

options.name: Piercing
options.text: Your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 piercing damage on a hit.

options.name: Slashing
options.text: Your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 slashing damage on a hit.

options.name: Night Vision
options.summary: Darkvision 60 ft; if you already have Darkvision, its range grows by 30 ft.
options.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet instead.
